name: faithful-port-review
description: Review, finish, or sweep a faithful port (C-to-Rust driver/protocol/filesystem/algorithm) before it merges or runs on real hardware. A silicon-faithful lens over the standard code-review stage: the green device-free mock can't be the check, so this review is. Covers the recurring divergence classes (mock-masked timing, wrong reference function, hardware-pointer identity) and is tolerant of correct-by-construction oxidation.
